subject: MedTech trial 	6 data residency, logging & retention follow-ups
body:
Thread: MedTech trial 	6 data residency, logging & retention follow-ups

--- Message 1/5 ---
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Anya Petrov <anya@medsys.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: MedTech trial 	6 data residency, logging & retention follow-ups

Hi Anya,

Thanks for the conversation earlier. Quick recap and the items we agreed we'd follow up on regarding data handling for the NovaMed pilot:

- Primary requirement: PHI and associated PII must remain stored in the United States (physically and logically) for the duration of retention.
- Backups & disaster recovery: you asked whether cross-region replication is allowed if the replicated copy is also physically stored in the US and encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key.
- Failover behavior: production failover to a non-US region should be restricted; you prefer read-only failover within US regions only. We need to confirm acceptable RTO/RPO.
- Logging & audit: NovaMed needs application request logs and system audit logs retained for 7 years; logs should be exportable and include redaction controls for patient identifiers.
- Metadata and telemetry: you flagged that dataset-level metadata and prompt text may contain PII — need confirmation if removing identifiers is acceptable versus full-text retention.

Attachments: redwood-datasheet.pdf (capabilities), residency-matrix.xlsx (starter matrix), soc2-summary.pdf

Next steps I propose:
1) Monica to put together a technical note on deployment options (hosted with US-only residency, dedicated capacity in your VPC, private on-prem option) + recommended config for backups and logging.
2) Schedule a 60-min technical deep dive with NovaMed security and our SE team next week. Proposed windows: Tue 26 May 10	612 ET or Wed 27 May 14	616 ET. Please confirm.
3) Send us any annotated residency matrix items you want us to address.

I'll loop in Monica and Marissa to start producing the technical and procurement artifacts.

Thanks,

Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

--- Message 2/5 ---
From: Anya Petrov <anya@medsys.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Dr. Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@novamed.org>, Jacob Wells <jwells@novamed.org>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 09:38:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MedTech trial 	6 data residency, logging & retention follow-ups

Thanks Sean 	6 helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- NovaMed's policy: all PHI and PII must be created, processed, and stored within the United States at all lifecycle stages. That includes backups and replicas. Cross-border copies (outside US borders) are not permitted, even for DR, unless we get explicit legal sign-off.
- Failover: we can tolerate read-only failover to another US region but only with prior configuration and customer approval. Active-active across regions is a no-go.
- Logs: we need access to raw request logs for auditing, but we require an option to mask patient identifiers before logs leave our environment. Where logs are stored must be disclosed.
- Metadata: prompt text that contains identifiers is considered PII for us. We will work with you on a pre-processing step to tokenize or redact identifiers before sending to Redwood.

I've attached a brief annotated version of the residency matrix (residency-matrix-annotated.xlsx). We'll confirm attendees for the deep dive tomorrow.

Best,
Anya
Director, Product Security
NovaMed Health
anya@medsys.ai

--- Message 3/5 ---
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Anya Petrov <anya@medsys.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dr. Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@novamed.org>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MedTech trial 	6 data residency, logging & retention follow-ups

Anya 	6 thanks for the annotated matrix and the clear constraints. Short answers while we pull the technical doc:

- Backups & replication: we can configure replication to stay within US boundaries (example: us-east-1 primary, us-west-2 replica) and enforce CMK policies so keys cannot be exported. We'll detail the KMS key policy and HSM options in the technical note.
- Failover: we can support read-only failover within US regions only; active-active will require a Private or Dedicated deployment and additional contractual controls.
- Logs: we offer configurable log retention and export. For pilot purposes we can enable PII redaction at the edge (pre-send hook) and provide an exportable, time-stamped audit log in an S3 bucket owned by NovaMed.
- Metadata handling: we recommend the preprocessing step you suggested. Monica will outline client-side redaction tokenization patterns we support.

Monica / Marissa 	6 can you confirm the timelines for the technical note and a rough cost delta for Dedicated vs Hosted with strict residency controls? Also adding Jacob from procurement on CC for any procurement questions.

Sean

--- Message 4/5 ---
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Anya Petrov <anya@medsys.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 08:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MedTech trial 	6 data residency, logging & retention follow-ups

Hi all 	6 technical follow-up and proposed options for NovaMed (high level):

Option A 	6 Hosted (Redwood managed, US-only)
- Data-at-rest and backups kept in US regions only. We can pin all storage and replicas to US accounts. CMK is customer-managed via AWS KMS; we provide key policy templates.
- Backup replication: us-east-1 -> us-west-2 within US. Encrypted in transit and at rest. We can disable cross-region replication to non-US.
- Logs: configurable retention up to 7 years. Export via S3 bucket in NovaMed account. We can enable redaction hooks and deliver raw or redacted logs per your preference.
- Timeline: 2	63 weeks to configure pilot environment.
- Cost: low delta versus standard hosted. We'll provide an estimate.

Option B 	6 Dedicated (reserved capacity)
- Dedicated GPU pool in NovaMed-only tenant in a US region. Suitable if you need stronger isolation and SLA.
- Active-active across regions is limited; we recommend single-primary with US failover.
- Timeline: 4	66 weeks provisioning. Higher cost (detailed estimate to follow).

Option C 	6 Private/VPC on-prem
- For air-gapped or highly regulated needs. On-prem package available; timeline and TCO depend on site readiness.

Next steps I recommend:
- We produce a short technical appendix (2	63 pages) that includes: KMS policy snippet, log export process, sample retention lifecycle, and redaction hook docs. I can have that to you by EOD Tue 26 May.
- Sean / Marissa: I need a procurement runbook with the required PO language and an initial cost delta for Dedicated vs Hosted. Jacob, can you share any procurement templates or MSA redlines we should expect?

Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

--- Message 5/5 ---
From: Jacob Wells <jwells@novamed.org>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Anya Petrov <anya@medsys.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 09:48:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MedTech trial 	6 data residency, logging & retention follow-ups

Thanks team 	6 appreciate the clarity. Procurement questions before we lock dates:

1) Can you confirm deletion SLA for data and backups after contract termination? We need guarantees on deletions and a cryptographic proof option.
2) For logs exported to our S3, can Redwood provide an automated export on a cadence or triggered by request? We prefer push to our bucket rather than Redwoods retaining copies.
3) Please provide a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) that lists owners, milestones, and documents required for pilot kickoff. We need MAP before PO.

We can take the 26 May slot for a technical deep dive (10:30	611:30 ET). Please share calendar invite and dial-in.

Jacob
Sr. Procurement Manager
NovaMed Health
jwells@novamed.org

End of thread
